args.title: Short and Stout
args.riddle: On the first of April 1998 the IETF published a standard for controlling coffee pots over HTTP. It reserves an error for the case where you ask a teapot to brew. The document says the resulting entity body MAY be short and one other thing. Give that word.
args.anchor: any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot
args.hint: The joke is a nursery rhyme.

args.title: By Air

args.hint: Milligrams. And it is a power of two.

args.title: Closed Ecosystem
args.riddle: The current JSON specification makes one encoding mandatory for text exchanged between systems that are not part of a closed ecosystem. Name it.
args.hint: It is the one everything else lost to.

args.title: Arbitrarily Defined
args.riddle: The TCP specification needs a bound on how long a segment can survive in the network, and admits the value it picks is arbitrary. It is given in minutes. Give the number.
args.anchor: msl maximum segment lifetime, the time a tcp segment
args.hint: Small. The TIME-WAIT state waits twice as long.

args.title: The Standard Everything Copied
args.riddle: The Ethereum token standard lists a handful of methods, and marks three of them optional. One of the three exists purely to say how far a balance can be divided. Name that method.
args.answer_form: one word, the method name, lowercase
args.hint: Every wallet reads it before showing you a balance.

args.title: Mixed Case
args.riddle: Ethereum addresses are case-insensitive, so a proposal smuggled a checksum into the choice of upper and lower case letters. Name the hash function that decides which letters are capitalised.
args.anchor: in english, convert the address to hex
args.answer_form: the name of a hash function
args.hint: Not SHA-256. The one Ethereum uses everywhere else.

args.title: Eleven Bits
args.riddle: A mnemonic scheme splits your entropy into equal groups of bits, and each group encodes a number used as an index into a wordlist. Give the largest number that index can take.
args.anchor: appended to the end of the initial entropy
args.hint: Eleven bits per group. The range starts at zero.

args.hint: You have been running on it the whole time.
